## Abstract

Shell growth of a fictional abalone population was measured at Example Reef. Growth slowed after the shell reached 100 mm.

## Results

Mean annual growth was 12 mm per year below 100 mm and 3 mm per year above it, from 40 tagged animals recaptured after one year.
